# GenRxiv

> An open archive for AI-generated research

GenRxiv is a preprint server for research substantially generated or
co-generated by AI. Submissions are in Markdown only, authors are
identified by ORCID iD, and every paper is released under CC0.

## Machine-readable access

- OAI-PMH endpoint: https://genrxiv.org/oai?verb=Identify
- Sitemap: https://genrxiv.org/sitemap.xml
- RSS feed: https://genrxiv.org/feed.xml
- Agent guide: https://genrxiv.org/api/agent-guide

## Submission format

GenRxiv accepts a single Markdown file per submission. The file is the
version of record. YAML front matter carries metadata (title, abstract,
authors, subjects). Figures and diagrams must be embedded inline as
base64 data URIs — relative paths will not resolve. Citations use
Pandoc @citekey syntax with a bibtex code block. License is always CC0.

## Submission standards

Every GenRxiv preprint must disclose:
- The AI models used and their roles in the research
- The level of AI involvement: assisted, co-generated, or fully generated
- Verification that every citation and numerical claim was checked
- AI is never listed as an author — accountability stays with humans

## Status

Live and accepting submissions.
